request:
镜头 s03：纪录片空镜，时长 7 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
风格模式：固定风格（style preset sp01-home48）。锁定外观 / Locked look（detailed_description 第一行必须照此书写，并逐字包含 ['consumer handheld family camera', 'low-bitrate']）：Locked look "2040s family home video" (style preset sp01-home48): a 2040s consumer handheld family camera on full auto; low-bitrate consumer digital video; fixed wide-normal zoom around 28mm equivalent at automatic, deep but soft focus; filter none; grade: warm faded beige, lifted greyish blacks, low saturation; light: available window daylight, auto-exposure pumping, highlights blooming; texture: macroblocking on motion, chroma noise in shadows, slight motion blur, focus hunting; remembered family footage: warm, soft, imperfect, held by a parent's hand.
该类型的纪录片默认机位：documentary establishing shot on a long zoom lens, atmospheric haze
导演意图（自然语言）：家用摄像机，缓慢推近窗口，轻微晃动。午后空无一人的厨房，阳光和灰尘落在摆着蜡笔和画纸的餐桌上；窗外远处的地平线上，一座巨大的行星发动机还包在脚手架和塔吊里。环境声：窗外城市的远声、风、远处工地隐约的金属敲击声。
情绪：calm, nostalgic, foreboding
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：wide shot, handheld home camera with one slow push in toward the window
景深与虚实：Soft home-video focus; the room slightly soft, the window view blooming with haze.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Establishing view of the Song family's empty kitchen on a warm afternoon in 2048, filmed on the family's home camera: sunlight and dust motes over the wooden table with crayons and drawing paper; through the window, far away on the hazy horizon, the half-built steel scaffold of a colossal planetary engine tower wrapped in construction cranes; the sun is still high in the sky. Blocking lock: the wooden table with crayons and paper in the lower foreground, the fridge with children's drawings at frame left, the window at frame right with the scaffolded engine tower on the horizon.
Picture 2: the Song family kitchen on the surface in 2048 (location reference; role: location reference). Interior of a small family apartment kitchen on the Earth's surface in 2048, late afternoon: warm sunlight through a window falls across a wooden table with crayons and sheets of drawing paper, a rice cooker and a teapot on the counter, children's drawings stuck on the fridge, a potted plant; through the window a hazy city skyline and, far away on the horizon, the half-built steel scaffold of a colossal engine tower with construction cranes. Empty of people, lived-in.
本镜头没有台词。
现场环境声：distant city hum through the window, a light breeze, faint far-off clang of construction metal
参考词汇（检索所得，只借用术语与思路，不要整段照抄，不得改变锁定外观）：
[ours/sound-home] 声音：家里的午后
[rules/lens/documentary-zoom] lens
[rules/move/slow-push-in] move
[ours/cam-push-reveal] 运镜：慢推揭示

画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

detailed_description:
16:9 horizontal, single clip 7.0s, 24fps, Locked look "2040s family home video" (style preset sp01-home48): a 2040s consumer handheld family camera on full auto; low-bitrate consumer digital video; fixed wide-normal zoom around 28mm equivalent at automatic, deep but soft focus; filter none; grade: warm faded beige, lifted greyish blacks, low saturation; light: available window daylight, auto-exposure pumping, highlights blooming; texture: macroblocking on motion, chroma noise in shadows, slight motion blur, focus hunting; remembered family footage: warm, soft, imperfect, held by a parent's hand; real documentary footage, not a movie, not CGI, unposed; no hard subtitles, no burned-in captions, no on-screen text, no logo, watermark or platform bugs.
[Shot 1] At 0.0s, wide shot, handheld consumer family camera with one slow push in from wide shot to a slightly tighter medium-wide framing centred on the window, drifting forward in one even, unhurried glide with the small uneven breathing sway of a camera held by a parent's hand; pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. Blocking at the start: the wooden table with crayons and drawing paper in the lower foreground, the fridge with children's drawings at frame left, the counter with rice cooker and teapot behind it, the window at frame right with the scaffolded engine tower small on the hazy horizon; the room empty of people. Start: the camera rests a moment on the table, the low sun cutting a warm band across the wood, and the auto-exposure eases down as the bright window enters the top of the frame. Middle: the camera creeps forward past the edge of the table; dust motes drift and turn slowly in the light beam, one corner of the top drawing paper lifts and settles in a faint draught, focus hunting slightly between the near crayons and the far glass, highlights blooming where the sun touches the window frame. End: the push settles with the window filling the right half of the frame, the half-built steel scaffold and its cranes now readable against the pale hazy horizon, one crane jib swinging a few degrees before the image holds. Mood: calm, nostalgic, foreboding. Blur: the near table edge and the fridge at frame left fall softly out of focus, the foreground room slightly soft overall, the window view blooming with haze, the far tower dissolving into a light grey-white glow. No character speaks any line in this shot; any human voices are indistinct, unintelligible Mandarin Chinese walla only. Hold the last frame.

overall_soundscape:
Room tone of a small apartment kitchen, the low hum of the fridge, a light breeze nudging the window frame, distant city hum through the glass, a faint far-off clang of construction metal from the horizon, a single faint paper rustle; raw production location sound only, dry and unscored, no background music.
